explanation: Q1 counts how many times each user appears as a followee (i.e., number of followers) among those who are both followees and followers. Q2 counts how many distinct followers each user has (as a followee) among those who are followers. Due to the use of COUNT(*) in Q1 and COUNT(DISTINCT) in Q2, they may differ if a followee has multiple entries with the same follower (though the schema prevents this). However, the key difference lies in the inclusion of users who are followers but not followees, which Q2 excludes via HAVING, while Q1 implicitly includes them if they are followees.
